attr.title: Resident Evil 4 Mobile
attr.desc: Experimental ARMHF port of the Resident Evil 4 Mobile engine for 640x480 Linux handhelds. Includes a bundled ARMHF runtime for older dArkOSRE/dArkOSEN glibc images. Audio and video playback are not complete in this build and hardware validation on the R36S is still required.
attr.desc_md: **Experimental port for R36S/dArkOS/dArkOSRE/dArkOSEN.** The game data and ARMHF host are included in this personal-use package. `PORT_32BIT=Y` is used for PortMaster compatibility; the launcher does not reject a firmware merely because it reports `DEVICE_ARCH=aarch64`. LCD rendering, physical controls, audio, cutscenes, saves and clean return to EmulationStation must still be validated on the target device.
attr.inst: All files are included in this package for personal use. Install on an ARMHF dArkOS/PortMaster system with the port folder intact.
attr.inst_md: Copy the archive contents to the PortMaster ports directory. Do not rename files inside `residentevil4/data/monhun/`; the extensions are the original engine extensions, not PNG files. The target must provide a working SDL2/GLES1-compatible display and ALSA audio path. This build uses PortMaster's `PORT_32BIT=Y` compatibility signal and no longer blocks on the reported `DEVICE_ARCH` value.
